name: Number theoretical method (NTM)
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中用数论构造代表性选点集的方法。
usage_overview: 用于在多维随机输入空间构造均匀散布的代表点，组织随机参数、轨道不平顺及联合激励的样本组合，以较少样本开展随机动力计算，也用于选择代表性不平顺谱样本。

complete_examples.text: In this model, the earthquake is expressed as non-stationary random process simulated by spectral representation and random function, and the track random irregularities with ergodic properties on amplitudes, wavelengths and probabilities are characterized by a track irregularity probabilistic model, and then the number theoretical method (NTM) is applied to effectively select representative samples of earthquakes and track random irregularities.

To the vehicle-track coupled system with stochastic nonlinearity and high-dimensional random variables, the number theoretical method (NTM) proposed by Li and Chen [32] can be applied to select the basic point set.

In this regard, a stochastic fractional derivative (SFD) model is proposed in this work based on Gru ̈ nwald representation of fractional calculus, the number theoretical method (NTM), and the probability density evolution method (PDEM).
